Owaisi challenges SIR process in Supreme Court

Asaduddin Owaisi has filed a petition in the Supreme Court challenging the process of the State Election Commission (SEC) and alleging irregularities in its decision-making. The petition specifically targets the "SIR" process, though details of what "SIR" refers to or the specific irregularities were not provided in the coverage.
